additionalProjects.name: Worktime Tracker
additionalProjects.description: Created during the start of the COVID-19 pandemic. A worktime tracking app for employees of the client that saved 3+ days/month of the client's time. The project was also submitted as the Internal Assessment for my International Baccalaureate Computer Science course (received a score of 7 over 7).

additionalProjects.name: Youtube-Sumarizr
additionalProjects.description: Submitted to PeddieHacks 2022 ($1000-cash Passion Prize and Best Education Track). This project allows users (intended to be students or teachers) to get auto-chapters or summaries of any youtube video. They can then choose to ask a ML bot questions about these chapters and get answers. This allows students to absorb content fast and easily.

additionalProjects.name: Trash-ure Map
additionalProjects.description: Won First Place in FiveHacks, Second Place in MergeHacks and Data Grind Hacks. A social media app for litter. Users post litter they've found online. Google Cloud Vision identifies the product (such as a Coca-cola can) and stores it in the database along with the location it is found. A crowdmap of the found data in respective regions is publicly provided, with the intention of being proof of litter and to hold companies like Coca-cola accountable for their litter.

computerVisionProjects.name: Images of the Russian Empire: Pixels
computerVisionProjects.description: This project involves aligning separate RGB channels of an image to create a cohesive RGB image. Techniques used include Normalized Cross Correlation and Gaussian Pyramid.

computerVisionProjects.name: Multiresolution Blending
computerVisionProjects.description: This project explores convolutional filters and image frequencies for edge detection, blurring, sharpening, morphing, and multi-resolution blending. It demonstrates how frequencies can manipulate images and create blending effects, similar to those seen in movies and animations.

computerVisionProjects.name: Face Morphing and Averaging with Delaunay Triangulation
computerVisionProjects.description: This project is about computer vision and image processing tasks on human faces, particularly face warping, face morphing, and face averaging. It involves defining correspondences, computing the 'mid-way face', creating a morphing sequence, computing the 'mean face' of a population, and creating caricatures.

computerVisionProjects.name: Automatic Image Alignment and Panorama Stitching
computerVisionProjects.description: This project involves taking several pictures of the same scene from different perspectives and automating the correspondence selection for image alignment. It includes detecting features, filtering them, matching features between images, computing homography, warping images, and blending them together.

computerVisionProjects.name: Diffusion Models Implementation
computerVisionProjects.description: This project is about playing with diffusion models, implementing diffusion sampling loops, and exploring the power of diffusion models. In the second part, we go deeper into the architecture of the diffusion model by implementing a unet and ddpm (Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models) from scratch. A denoising diffusion model is essentially a UNet. We can implement a UNet from scratch. The UNet is a neural network that takes an image and predicts the noise to add to the image to denoise it.
